components.name: Alert
components.description:
# Purpose
Communicates a system-level status message that requires user awareness or a follow-up action. Used at page or section scope — **not tied to a single field or inline element**.

# Use when
- A system event (error, warning, success, or informational notice) applies to the entire page or a major section
- The message includes a primary action (e.g. retry, undo) or a dismiss control
- Feedback must be prominently visible and not buried within content

# Don't use when
- The message is contextual to a specific row, record, or inline element — use `InlineAlert` instead
- The status is a passive label that doesn't need user acknowledgment

# Content guidelines
- **Title:** one short phrase; 60 characters max; sentence case
- **Body:** expand on the title only when the cause or resolution is non-obvious; omit if the title is self-explanatory
- **Action label:** 1–3 words; use a verb ("Retry", "View details"); never "Click here"
- Dismiss is optional — include only when the user should be able to clear the message manually

# Related
- Use `InlineAlert` instead when the message is scoped to a specific piece of inline content rather than the whole page or section

💬 description#55936:49.defaultValue: In a perfect world, content stays brief. Yet, when more words are essential, it unfolds like this.
